title: WALTEUR brownfield baseline snapshot
description: Machine-checkable portion of walteur-kit/baseline.json (the BASELINE-phase contract, §2.6 BROWNFIELD UPGRADE). The 'before' snapshot captured BEFORE the first upgrade edit, so the non-regression gate can prove after >= before on every dimension. Without a baseline, 'we improved it' and 'we didn't break it' are both unprovable. Pairs with a characterization (golden-master) test net that locks current observable behavior. Enforced by baseline-capture-gate.sh (detect-or-SKIP, brownfield-only).

captured_ts.description: ISO-8601 capture time — MUST be before the first upgrade edit; the ordering law is enforced by phase-gate (baseline is a plan-stage artifact, edits are build-stage)

build.description: does the app build today, as-is?

evidence.description: command-output ref / log path proving the status

tests.description: the existing test suite result today (the floor the upgrade must not drop below)

dimensions.description: the 8-dimension WALTEUR scoreboard measured on the app AS-IS — the per-dimension 'before' numbers the non-regression gate compares against. Each MUST carry a numeric score so after>=before is computable.

name.description: e.g. correctness, security, design, performance, accessibility, maintainability, completeness, UX

score.description: the as-is score on WALTEUR's 0-10 scale

evidence.description: what the score is grounded in (a measurement, a tool run, a file:line audit)

layers_coverage.description: the §14 13-layer coverage of the app AS-IS — which production layers exist vs are missing (the completeness 'before')

security.description: the security posture before the upgrade (secret-scan / dependency advisories / known holes)

performance.description: measured perf/a11y/bundle before the upgrade (Lighthouse, bundle size, p95) where applicable

characterization.description: the golden-master safety net — characterization tests that LOCK the app's current observable behavior so an upgrade cannot silently change it. status=present requires a runnable command/path; status=absent-with-reason demands an explicit reason (e.g. 'pure static site, behavior is the rendered DOM, snapshotted').

command.description: the command that runs the characterization/golden-master suite
